query:
INSERT INTO sms_templates (slug, name, description, messageTemplate, category, isActive) VALUES 
('vip-welcome', 'VIP Welcome Message', 'Sent when a new member joins the VIP Spicy Stories Club', '🎉 Welcome to the VIP Spicy Stories Club, {{name}}! Your {{tier}} membership is now active. Get ready for exclusive steamy stories, audio narrations, and more! 📚💕 - Reese Astor', 'vip', 1),
('new-story-release', 'New Story Release Alert', 'Sent when a new exclusive story is published', '🔥 Hot off the press, {{name}}! A new steamy story is waiting for you: "{{storyTitle}}" Listen now in your VIP Audio Library! 🎧 - Reese Astor', 'vip', 1),
('order-confirmation', 'Order Confirmation', 'Sent when an order is placed', '📦 Order confirmed! Your order #{{orderNumber}} for "{{itemName}}" is being processed. Thank you for your purchase! - Reese Astor', 'order', 1),
('subscription-renewal', 'Subscription Renewal Reminder', 'Sent before subscription renewal', '⏰ Heads up, {{name}}! Your VIP membership renews in 3 days. Keep enjoying unlimited steamy stories! 💕 - Reese Astor', 'vip', 1),
('book-launch', 'Book Launch Announcement', 'Sent when a new book is released', '📚 NEW RELEASE! "{{bookTitle}}" is now available! As a VIP member, you get early access. Grab your copy now! 🔥 - Reese Astor', 'marketing', 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name=VALUES(name), description=VALUES(description), messageTemplate=VALUES(messageTemplate);
